name: Chained [2 Player Obby]
desc:
⚠️THIS GAME IS MADE FOR 2 PLAYERS⚠️

Navigate a thrilling obstacle course with a friend. Chained together, you'll need to cooperate to reach the end. But it won't be easy—you're chained, so teamwork is key! 🔑

🎁 You can win a free Chain by liking the game and joining the group 🎁 -> https://www.roblox.com/groups/34327520/1-Day

Controls :

PC 💻 : HOLD "E" TO PULL
MOBILE 📱 : PRESS PULL BUTTON -- STOP PULLING : PRESS PULL BUTTON BACK
CONSOLE 🎮 : HOLD "R2/RT" TO PULL
